data.name: Namir
data.gender_notes: Namir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who comforts, consoles, restores, revives, and soothes. The name Namir carries the meaning “Comforter, Restorer, Consoler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Namir usually hope their child will grow to embody comforter, restorer, consoler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a protector and caretaker, inspiring comfort and compassion in those around him.
data.etymology: Namir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforter, Restorer, Consoler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Namir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
